messages:
Anna P: quick sync — Marketplace team asked for a compliance bundle to approve our listing. They want: SOC 2 Type II (PDF), latest pen-test redacted, vuln scan report, questionnaire (CCPA/GDPR bits), and a remediation tracker. Deadline: EOD Wednesday PDT.

Samir K: @Anna can you confirm which SOC scope they need? organization-level or product-level?

Anna P: They specifically called out 'SOC 2 Type II covering our inference service and control environment' — so org + service. Also they asked that the system description mentions 'Redwood Inference hosted API and Dedicated offering' explicitly.

Jordan L: I can collect items. Do we have a redacted pen-test we can share today?

Kevin M: We do. RedTeamSec did our last assessment 2025-11. Redacted PDF is in the security bucket: `s3://redwood-security/marketplace/pentest-redacted-202511.pdf`. I'll add ACLs for reviewer@marketplace.com. :locks:

Samir K: Also add the remediation tracker CSV. We need to surface high/critical findings and current status. I can export an offboarded version without issue IDs.

DevSecOps Bot: Vulnerability scan (weekly) finished: 18 findings total — 2 high (open), 5 medium (3 open), rest low. Scan report: `https://snyk.redwood.internal/reports/scan-20260315` (access requires VPN).

Anna P: Thanks. Marketplace wants signatures via an intake form; Jordan please fill the questionnaire and attach artifacts. I'll coordinate with sales/legal for the NDA redaction.

Jordan L: Uploading draft bundle to the partnership folder now. I'll add a README.md with the scope statements and point to the SOC report. :arrow_up:

Kevin M: FYI — SOC 2 report is from 2026-01 and has vendor redactions. It's good for 12 months from the report period. I'll confirm with compliance if a bridge letter is needed.

Samir K: Action items:
- Jordan: assemble questionnaire + README + zip artifacts (owner)
- Kevin: confirm SOC scope and share redacted PDF link (owner)
- Samir: export remediation tracker and redact sensitive issue IDs (owner)
- Anna: coordinate reviewer ACLs and intake form submission (owner)
Deadline: Wednesday EOD PDT. Please update thread when done.

Anna P: One more — marketplace sometimes asks for evidence of pen-test remediation verification (e.g., retest summary). If we don't have a full retest, can we provide patch dates and mitigation notes? @Samir thoughts?

Samir K: Yes, provide mitigation notes and evidence (PRs/patch dates). If they insist, we can offer a scoped retest quote, but that will take time.

Jordan L: All items uploaded except remediation tracker — will add when Samir shares. Filing intake form after Kevin confirms ACLs.

Kevin M: ACLs set, confirmed reviewer@marketplace.com has read access for 72h.

Anna P: Awesome — if anyone hits blockers flag me. :tada:

Samir K: Will share tracker by EOD today. :thumbsup:

Jordan L: Noted. Updating task board. :white_check_mark:
